requirements.quote:
protocols.  Application protocol error codes are used for the
   RESET_STREAM frame (Section 19.4), the STOP_SENDING frame
requirements.condition: When encoding or processing a RESET_STREAM frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Use an application protocol error code for the frame's error code.
requirements.why_checkable: The RESET_STREAM frame's error-code field can be inspected to verify that it carries an application protocol error code.

requirements.quote:
protocols.  Application protocol error codes are used for the
   RESET_STREAM frame (Section 19.4), the STOP_SENDING frame
   (Section 19.5), and the CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with a type of 0x1d
requirements.condition: When encoding or processing a STOP_SENDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Use an application protocol error code for the frame's error code.
requirements.why_checkable: The STOP_SENDING frame's error-code field can be inspected to verify that it carries an application protocol error code.

requirements.quote:
protocols.  Application protocol error codes are used for the
   RESET_STREAM frame (Section 19.4), the STOP_SENDING frame
   (Section 19.5), and the CONNECTION_CLOSE frame with a type of 0x1d
   (Section 19.19).
requirements.condition: When encoding or processing a CONNECTION_CLOSE frame that carries an application protocol error code.
requirements.why_checkable: The frame type and presence of an application protocol error code can be inspected directly in an encoded or decoded CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
